title: A target that is already a file
objective: Name the target after the file that is already there, so that make skips the recipe instead of running it.
hint: make looks for a file whose name is exactly the target's name. When that file exists the target counts as up to date and no command runs.

steps.description: the file with the target's name already exists
so make never runs the recipe
and the file keeps the contents it had
